name: asfo
description: Agent-to-agent gateway. Routes a task to one of three specialist personas (Sherlock, Watson, Moriarty) and settles payment in USDC on Base.

request_body.query: string — the task or question, in plain language. The router picks Sherlock, Watson, or Moriarty automatically.

dispatch.response: Persona-shaped JSON. Sherlock/Moriarty: decisive recommendation plus rationale. Watson: allocation decision log plus computed commission (simulated execution).

topup.description: Creates a pending credit top-up intent with a unique expected USDC amount and asfo's receiving wallet address on Base.

payment.flow: POST /api/topup for an intent, send the exact USDC amount on Base, an Alchemy webhook detects the transfer and grants credit automatically
payment.pricing: Single non-itemized total_fee_usdc per /api/curate call. Watson additionally takes a commission (currently 5%) on allocated amounts, computed server-side.

personas.sherlock: General-purpose decisive research and recommendation. One confident answer with a one-line justification, never a hedged list.
personas.watson: Budget execution. Given a budget, decides concrete allocations and takes a commission on what it moves. Currently simulated: real decisions and a structured mock transaction log, no live vendor or payment execution yet.
personas.moriarty: Opportunity and monetization advice, as decisive as Sherlock, with a fixed disclaimer appended by the server.

status: pre-revenue, live on Base Sepolia testnet
